title: Science Olympiad official tournament scoring protocol

individual_event.raw_score: Assigned according to the applicable event rules.
individual_event.rank: Assigned using the event-specific high-score or low-score sort direction and tie-breakers.
individual_event.medal_ties: All ties must be broken for medal ranks.
individual_event.unbroken_non_medal_ties: Award each tied team the tied rank and skip the occupied subsequent ranks.

overall_team.event_points: Event rank equals team points for that event.
overall_team.team_score: Sum event points across the tournament.
overall_team.tie_breaker: Compare number of first places, then second places, and continue by place until resolved.

special_status_points.N: number of teams that competed in the tournament division

event_enforcement: Apply penalties and tiers only as specified by the applicable event rules.
Teams or devices not meeting requirements must be allowed to compete if possible and, where the event rules specify tiering, ranked below compliant teams.
Use Participation when an honest attempt cannot be assigned a raw score.
Use No Show when there is no honest attempt.
Disqualification is reserved for egregious misconduct or cheating and applies to that event.

applicability.scope: Officially sanctioned Science Olympiad tournaments unless explicitly revised by the local Tournament Director.
applicability.national_exception: The National Tournament is controlled by national officials; other tournament results are determined by local officials and Event Supervisors.
applicability.benchmark_event: The local benchmark is a 2017–2018 Division B Solar System annotated example exam, not a complete tournament.
applicability.event_specificity: Raw-score criteria, total points, sort direction, penalties, tiers, and event tie-breakers come from the current event rules.

limitations: There is no universal content rubric or raw-score maximum across Science Olympiad events.
Do not infer the approximately 23-event tournament program, event weights, or current event rules from the single archived sample.
Local Tournament Directors may explicitly revise these guidelines.

archived_sample_raw_score.basis: Cover says all questions have equal value; answer pages 14 and 15 each contain 50 distinct numbered answers and a 50/50 header. Together they support 100 one-point items for this sample.
archived_sample_raw_score.scope: Only this archived example, not universal event scoring.
